in_marathi.name: Jagu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Leaper, Vehicle, Victor
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Jagu is a name for the divine vehicle of Lord Shiva, a powerful and swift being. The name Jagu can also be derived from the Sanskrit word jagati, meaning 'to conquer' or 'to rule'.
